build_IMASConfig_geometry: build a StandardGeometry from a single IMAS IDS time slice using IMASConfig
build_IMASConfig_provider: build a time-dependent StandardGeometryProvider interpolating across all IMAS IDS time slices
validate_IMASConfig_inputs: validate that IMASConfig has exactly one of imas_filepath, imas_uri, or equilibrium_object
create_IMASConfig_single_slice: create an IMASConfig instance loading a single time slice by index or time from an IMAS netCDF file
create_IMASConfig_all_slices: create an IMASConfig instance loading all time slices from an IMAS equilibrium IDS for time-dependent geometry
